Tests page extraction and page marker configuration

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"pages\":{\"extract_pages\":true,\"insert_page_markers\":true}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
